title.zh: 为什么必须等 -5% 浅回撤，既不追高也不等 -8% 深跌？
title.en: Why -5% Shallow Pullback Beats Both Chasing (0%) and Deep Pullbacks (-8%)

detail.zh: 6,912 组全网格实证显示：突破次日直接市价追高（0% 回撤）10 年仅 3.48x（夏普 0.70）；而挂 -8% 过深回撤会严重触发「逆向选择」——真正超级大牛股突破后极少跌破 -8%，能买到的往往是假突破弱势股。-5% 限价单以 62.2% 成交率精准卡在机构洗盘甜点区。
detail.en: Across 6,912 tested combinations, chasing next-open (0% pullback) yields only 3.48x (Sharpe 0.70), while waiting for -8% suffers severe adverse selection (true momentum leaders rarely dip -8%; weak fakeouts always fill). A -5% limit captures a 62.2% fill rate right at institutional shakeout support.

title.zh: 为什么 ATR 波动率自适应止损同时击败「无止损」与「-7% 固定紧止损」？
title.en: Why Volatility-Scaled ATR Stops Beat Both No-Stop and Fixed -7% O'Neil Stops

detail.zh: 热门高换手龙头日常日均振幅即达 3.5%-4.5%：固定 -7% 紧止损会被日常噪音频繁洗出（收益腰斩至 4.35x）；而完全不设止损在遭遇周期见顶或退市股（全样本含 183 只退市股）时最大回撤深达 -46% 至 -55%。2.5x-3.5x ATR14 让每只股票按自身波动率呼吸。
detail.en: High-dollar-volume leaders routinely swing 3.5%-4.5% per day: a rigid -7% stop whipsaws out of winners (halving wealth to 4.35x), whereas running without a hard stop suffers -46% to -55% drawdowns across delistings and regime breaks. Scaling stops by 2.5x-3.5x ATR14 adapts risk to each stock's true noise floor.

title.zh: 为什么宽松止盈（4.0x ATR 吊灯 / +25% 目标）碾压 MA20 紧止盈？
title.en: Why Loose Trend-Riding Exits Crush Tight MA20 Profit-Taking

detail.zh: 趋势交易的核心正期望来自右尾大赢家（旗舰版盈亏比高达 2.86:1）：若跌破 MA20 即匆忙清仓，10 年累计净值仅剩 1.57x（年化仅 4.6%，大幅跑输 SPY 的 4.05x）。4.0x ATR14 吊灯止盈与 +25% 宽目标完整保留了 NVDA、PLTR、TSLA 等主升段复利。
detail.en: Right-tail multi-baggers drive momentum expectancy (2.86x payoff ratio in Flagship). Exiting on the first close below MA20 chokes off compounding at 1.57x over 10 years (underperforming SPY's 4.05x). Trailing 4.0x ATR14 or targeting +25% lets institutional trends compound.

guardrails.zh: 零幸存者偏差（Point-in-Time）：基于 Fact OS 完整收录的 Sharadar 美股普通股日频库，包含回测期内全部退市与被并购普通股（共 183 只曾进入高成交额池的已退市标的），退市末日按最后有效收盘扣除卖出成本清算。
guardrails.en: Zero Survivorship Bias (PIT): Built on Fact OS Sharadar daily equity tables including all 183 delisted/acquired common stocks that ever entered the top liquidity cohort; delistings liquidate at final valid session close net of exit cost.

guardrails.zh: 交易摩擦与成交保守性：双边计入 10 bps 交易成本（买入 5 bps + 卖出 5 bps）；若次日开盘跳空低开跌破限价单则按更优开盘价成交，若跳空低开跌破止损位则严格按不利开盘价滑点出局，杜绝理想化撮合偏差。
guardrails.en: Execution & Gap Realism: Charges 10 bps round-trip friction (5 bps entry + 5 bps exit); overnight gap-downs below hard/trailing stops execute conservatively at the worse morning open price, never assuming impossible stop fills.
